$meta.readThisFirst: Figma's own descriptions for this component are provably wrong (they advertise an S/M/L size axis and a 'loading' state that do not exist). Read bound variables and node structure; treat Figma prose as unverified.

anatomy.note: One anatomy for all 8 types. Verified at set level across 8 of 8 sets: every set binds identical geometry and typography tokens; only the colour namespace differs.

minHeight.note: THE design-system gap. Height is set by min-height ONLY — padding-block is spacing/none = 0, which is 0 in every density mode, so height can never emerge from padding.
minHeight.whyNotFixedHeight: Figma emits the min- form; W3C C42 recommends min-height for target sizing; W3C C28 warns fixed units clip text when users enlarge type. Split is the only type using fixed height and cannot grow (defect F-008).

paddingInline.rule: 8px on the icon side, 12px on the label side. Mirrors with icon position.

iconBox.note: Wrapper and glyph are both size-[18px]. Will NOT scale with density because it is unbound.

letterSpacing.gap: G2 — bound in Figma but ABSENT from tokens.css

compactDelta.note: get_variable_defs on standard 5703:7088 and compact 5703:7158 returns BYTE-IDENTICAL output.
compactDelta.why: Compact and standard buttons appear on the same screen, so this cannot be modelled as a global density mode.

alphaIsLoadBearing.warning: action/focus/ring = #00000066 (40%), border/transparent = #00000000 (0%). A pipeline that reads only the hex field and drops alpha renders every focus ring a solid black bar and every disabled border a solid black line.

namingException.impact: A generic 'build the token name from the type name' helper WILL break on Secondary.

colourFormula.figmaCardsAreWrong: Figma's doc cards print action/{type}/text. That name is correct for Secondary ONLY.
